preconditions.description: The number of rows and columns in the matrix is between 1 and 100, inclusive.
The number of ones to be placed in the matrix is between 0 and 10^6, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (output is a matrix and output is symmetrical and output is lexicographically maximal)
postconditions.description: The output is either -1 if no such matrix exists, or a matrix that is symmetrical and lexicographically maximal.
